title: Phool Aur Angaar
desc: A young man rescues a woman from being molested but gets accused of the heinous crime instead. Trying to apprehend the miscreants, he gets caught in a web of deception and lies.

title: Budkaar
desc: Mini, a young woman, is kidnapped from a pub and police investigate the case. However, when her sister sets out to find her, she uncovers a criminal nexus which shakes the city.

title: Aadmi Aur Insaan
desc: Jai and Munish's friendship is ruined when both of them fall in love with the same girl, Meena. Things take a turn when Munish finds out Jai was involved in the case of a faulty railway bridge.

title: Train To Pakistan
desc: The film is set in Mano Majra, which is a quiet fictional village on the border of India and Pakistan, close to where the railway line crosses the Sutlej River. The film develops around the love affair of small-time dacoit Juggut Singh (Nirmal Pandey), with a local Muslim girl, Nooran (Smriti Mishra).

title: Hitler
desc: Siddhanth Sharma, a strict disciplinarian, is forced to chase hi brother, Amar, after he is accused of murder. However, his wife, Sheila, a lawyer, decides to defend Amar.
